target_applicability: Different controller. No constants below adopted as Xbox 1708 parameters.
unit_policy: Values are recorded in source CAD numeric units; source files do not explicitly declare SI units. No automatic conversion to target metres.
findings: ABXY source constructs bottom retention shape, transition loft, upper shaft and chamfer separately. These are geometric features, not button travel.
Thumbstick cap includes dome, shaft interface hole, and separate XY/Z fit allowances. Dome radius does not establish the internal joystick hinge.
R1 source contains shaft, bridge, switch-contact relief and manufacturing tolerances. Contact tolerance is not spring displacement or actuation force.

The four inspected part sources do not define mass, density, inertia, friction, damping, force-displacement law or simulation joints. This is useful manufacturing CAD, not a ready-made validated dynamics asset.
Alpakka D-pad button geometry is not transferable to the single cross-shaped Xbox 1708 cap.
harness: scripts/audit_cad_reference.py checks every downloaded file hash and named numeric literals without importing/executing third-party CAD
